scope_note: Only the documented legacy recovery-required transition resolves an authenticated user's explicit manual selection. Directory and original-device membership must be freshly verified, while existing recovery scope and credential shape remain unchanged. The plural tests/ helper is listed because the generic scanner classifies it as source; it remains test-only and is checked for exclusion from production bundles. Unit doubles are not live acceptance. Live acceptance uses the independent coordinator, actual dshkerd CLI and an isolated Linux OS Secret Service; its archive digest and run/head identity must verify before raw events can pass. No installed production credentials or active DSH are used. Physical Win/Mac acceptance is separate.

field_bindings.field: original recovery endpoint error terminates issuance before post-issue readback
field_bindings.source: Actual recovery call error, the existing typed certificate mapping and the original canonical credential.
field_bindings.missing_semantics: A recovery refusal returns its typed mapped error, no success result, no post-issue readback, no replacement identity and no clearing of a valid login.

field_bindings.test: returns the exact digest with its file already closed for %j
field_bindings.field: verified runtime digest is not published before its owned file descriptor closes
field_bindings.source: Exact file bytes, a synchronous read/close barrier and the existing verified-stage publication path.
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Missing or unreadable files throw before producing a digest; no EPERM retry, delay or alternate runtime publication.

field_bindings.test: freshly verifies the current user and exact manual network with the original device
field_bindings.field: explicit selected network belongs to the authenticated account and contains the original device
field_bindings.source: Current coordinator user, account-scoped manual selection, fresh coordinator directory and a stable token/selection/lifecycle owner.
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Missing selection remains recovery-required; foreign/deleted/unbound scope is forbidden; unavailable/malformed reads fail explicitly, and changed owners cancel rather than choosing another network.

field_bindings.test: recovers the exact verified manual scope while preserving every legacy identity field
field_bindings.field: one scoped recovery changes only the original certificate and fully reads it back
field_bindings.source: Original credential identity and revision; the core's exact typed refusal admits only one verified legacy-scope transition.
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Never re-enroll, infer a network, rewrite an existing network ID, weaken persistence checks or accept stale token/selection/lifecycle work.

field_bindings.test: recovers after an explicit manual selection without another login or enrollment
field_bindings.field: manual network selection schedules the same serialized lifecycle-owned certificate maintenance
field_bindings.source: Persisted explicit network selection under the current account, existing device-session single flight and service-session status.
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Failed selection persistence or closed lifetime cannot schedule recovery. Login stays valid when scope is missing or forbidden; DSH and device registration are never started.

field_bindings.test: reads canonical partial success after desktop storage failure and restart without another scope
field_bindings.field: test-only legacy identity and partial-write composition; excluded from production imports and artifacts
field_bindings.source: Isolated test-side credential state and explicit test ownership; no production root imports this helper.
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Test doubles validate only the Electron boundary, never replace required real CLI/coordinator/OS-store evidence or production dependencies.

real_commands.command: npm run environment:check && npm run architecture:check && npm run format:check && npm run type-check
cd networking && go vet ./... && go test -json -race -count=1 ./internal/controlplane ./internal/helper ./internal/localrpc ./internal/core > ../.run/legacy-certificate-recovery/core-tests.jsonl

cd networking && test -f "${DSHKER_SERVER_BINARY:?explicit verified coordinator binary required}" && go test -json -race -count=1 -run '^TestCertificateRealCoordinator(Lifecycle|UnboundRecovery)$' ./integration > ../.run/legacy-certificate-recovery/local-real-coordinator.jsonl
npm run test:e2e && npm run service:smoke && npm run visual:smoke && npm run build && npm run build:electron

gh run view "${DSHKER_CLIENT_CI_RUN_ID:?explicit client CI run required}" --repo ankye/dshker --json headSha,status,conclusion,url > .run/legacy-certificate-recovery/client-quality.json && gh api "repos/ankye/dshker/actions/runs/${DSHKER_CLIENT_CI_RUN_ID}/artifacts" --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.name == "certificate-lifecycle-linux-process")' > .run/legacy-certificate-recovery/certificate-artifact.json

node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import crypto from "node:crypto"; import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; const root=".run/legacy-certificate-recovery/"; const revision=execFileSync("git",["rev-parse","HEAD"],{encoding:"utf8"}).trim(); const ci=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(root+"client-quality.json","utf8")); if(ci.headSha!==revision||ci.status!=="completed"||ci.conclusion!=="success") throw Error("client CI is not green for exact HEAD"); const artifact=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(root+"certificate-artifact.json","utf8")); if(artifact.expired||artifact.name!=="certificate-lifecycle-linux-process"||artifact.workflow_run.head_sha!==revision||artifact.workflow_run.id!==Number(process.env.DSHKER_CLIENT_CI_RUN_ID)) throw Error("certificate artifact ownership mismatch"); const zip=execFileSync("gh",["api","repos/ankye/dshker/actions/artifacts/"+artifact.id+"/zip"],{maxBuffer:16000000}); if("sha256:"+crypto.createHash("sha256").update(zip).digest("hex")!==artifact.digest) throw Error("certificate artifact archive digest mismatch"); fs.writeFileSync(root+"certificate-process.zip",zip); const raw=execFileSync("unzip",["-p",root+"certificate-process.zip","linux-real-process.jsonl"],{encoding:"utf8"}); const rows=raw.trim().split("\n").map(JSON.parse); if(rows.some(row=>row.Action==="fail"||row.Action==="skip")) throw Error("certificate process failed or skipped"); for(const name of ["TestCertificateRealCoordinatorLifecycle","TestCertificateRealCoordinatorCLICredentialReadback","TestCertificateRealCoordinatorCLILegacyRecovery","TestCertificateRealCoordinatorCLILegacyScopeRefusals"]) if(!rows.some(row=>row.Action==="pass"&&row.Test===name)) throw Error("required process test did not pass: "+name); fs.writeFileSync(root+"linux-real-process.jsonl",raw); for(const file of ["out/main/index.cjs","out/preload/index.cjs","out/preload/workbench.cjs"]) {const body=fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8"); for(const marker of ["legacyCertificateFixture","newCertificateLegacyCLI","vi.mock","vitest"]) if(body.includes(marker)) throw Error("test support reached production bundle: "+marker);}'
